items: App launches and routes past splash correctly
Offline screen appears when internet is unavailable
WebView loads allowed DressFair domain pages
Non-allowlisted links open in external browser
Account tab routes to login when signed out
Login on web inside WebView saves auth token (SecureStore-backed; survives kill-relaunch)
Logout clears native session and opens web logout (re-launch shows logged-out state)
Push pre-permission dialog appears with Allow / Not now copy on first launch
Tapping Allow then granting at OS prompt registers the token; tracked event push_token_registered
Tapping Not now skips the OS prompt (push_permission_skipped_pre_prompt event)
Notification/deeplink opens expected WebView path
Custom-scheme deep link `dressfair://web?path=/p/<slug>` opens the right WebView path
Settings -> Notification preferences opens system Settings
Settings -> Help and support opens the support email composer (or in-app fallback)
Settings -> Privacy policy opens https://www.dressfair.com/privacy in OS browser
Settings -> Terms and conditions opens the terms URL in OS browser
Settings -> Delete account shows the warning Alert and opens the deletion page on Continue
Payment callback URLs emit redirect telemetry; checkout via the live gateway succeeds end-to-end
Hardware Back inside WebView navigates back, then exits the app at the storefront root
No loading/error state leaves blank screen
Manifest contains only INTERNET + VIBRATE permissions in the production AAB
